notes.title: I.P.U Demo Released~★
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/25fafaadb47df2cb58c08a7b7d9b7a72c4940a84.png[/img]
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

The [b]Demo[/b] of [b]「I will Purify you!」[/b] has finally been released!!!
Yheee~★
 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406670/__DEMO/
[b]「I will Purify you!」[/b] is a [b]pixel art action roguelike[/b] game where you become a hunter and hunt monsters.

In the demo, you can enjoy the action content excluding various roguelike contents currently in development and the story of purifying Sister Emily who has fallen into a ghoul! Below is a list of features that will be added in the official release, so please show us your interest and love!

We'll come back with more good titles and news.
Sato's report is over!
 
 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/a604b6770cba33270e52decc96a1703a5db38f24.png[/img]
· Equipment combination that allows you to obtain more powerful hidden equipment by combining two pieces of equipment.

· Account Lv that grows through battles and account skills that make characters stronger.

· Various playable characters with their own special status and skills.

· A shop where you can unlock new equipment and obtain the equipment you want before battle.

· Drop items that help in battles, such as health recovery, range attacks, and invincibility.

· More fun and detailed combat balance.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

I'm back to report that we've added new features that I reported on before!!!
Yheee~♥

We are also preparing to add the Chinese language, so please ask for your interest and love.

Please refer to the report below for more details~★
Sato's report is over!

[b][h2]※ Ver. 1.00.00 → 1.01.00[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]· Skip function added[/b][/h3]
- The skip function has been added so that you can quickly turn the story and receive LUA's love.
- The skip button is located at the top left of the ingame.
- After click skip button, press another area again to cancel the skip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257666/1189f73502dba8659a65f4771d565e68f75395a8.png[/img]

[h3][b]· 1st Event Scene Update[/b][/h3]
- When you first start Honey Trap, LUA's first event scene changed from camera move to Live 2D.
- You can also check out the changed event scene in the gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257666/17eacbc6e06bef509d040d4878f6f0564a635874.png[/img]

notes.title: "Body Pay OMG!" Release date notice
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/6216eb3d793e3900cf67feaf5f689cb4e45db786.png[/img]
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

Always a hardworking secretary, that Sato has good news!!!
Yay-★

The sequel to "Body Pay" that many sir have been asking about, "Body Pay OMG!", will be released on January 24, 2025 at 16:00 (PDT).
Ta-da!!!

Originally, it was going to be released as a DLC for "Body Pay", but since some users in countries including Korea were unable to use it, so we release it as a separate title.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282510/Body_Pay/

"Body Pay OMG!" has a story mode consisting of a puzzle game and 12 stories, and a puzzle mode consisting of 20 puzzle games of various difficulty that you can collect Steam acheivement.
[b]※ You must download the free DLC to enjoy the story and animation.[/b]

We'll come back with more good titles and news.
I ask for your interest and love!!!

Sato's report is over!
